blocks.text: Birds (parindon) ke jism par feathers (par) hote hain. Feathers urne ki satah banate hain jo lift (upar uthne ki taqat) deti hai aur rukh badalne mein madad karti hai. Feathers garmi aur paani ko zaya hone se bhi rokte hain. Birds endotherms hain, yani apne cells ke processes se garmi hasil karte hain. Andar ki is garmi se yeh jism ke andar ka (core) temperature taqreeban ek jaisa rakhte hain. Jo janwar apna core temperature ek jaisa rakh sakte hain unhein homeotherms kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Teen parindon ke sar. Upar baayen: kaala sar, patli chonch jis ka sira peela hai: 'Insect and seed eater' (keere aur beej dono khane wala). Upar daayen: kaala sar, chhoti moti makhrooti (cone) chonch: 'Seed eater' (beej khane wala). Neeche beech mein: peela-kaala sar, patli nokili narangi chonch: 'Insect eater' (keere khane wala).
blocks.caption: Chonch aur zubaan khane ki aadaton ke mutabiq badli hoti hain (kitab ke box ki chhapi tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka)
blocks.long_description: Labels: Insect and seed eater, Seed eater, Insect eater.

blocks.text: Parindon ki chonch (bill) aur zubaan khane ki mukhtalif aadaton aur khurak ke hisaab se badli hui hoti hain: beej khane wale ki chonch moti aur keere khane wale ki patli hoti hai.

Parindon ka jism streamlined aur takli (spindle) jaisa hota hai. Agle limbs (forelimbs) wings ban gaye hain. Haddiyon mein hawa ki bari jagahen hoti hain, is liye yeh halki hoti hain. Daanton ki jagah ek halka ghilaaf hota hai jise bill (chonch) kehte hain. Seene ki haddi (sternum) par ek bari haddi, keel, hoti hai jis se urne ke muscles jure hote hain.

Bohat se parindon mein oesophagus ki ek thaili (diverticulum), crop, khana jama karti hai, taake parinda jaldi se bohat sa khana nigal sake. Stomach ka ek hissa, gizzard, muscular deewaron se khane ko peesta hai. Dil chaar chambers ka hai, jis mein atria aur ventricles poori tarah alag hain. Parindon ka nervous system bohat achha bana hai. Zyada tar parindon ke liye dekhna (vision) aur sunna (hearing) sab se aham hiss (senses) hain.

blocks.alt: Safed par teen parinde: upar baayen Emu, bhoora jhabra na urne wala parinda jis ka sar jhuka hua aur tangen lambi hain; upar daayen Kiwi, gol bhoora na urne wala parinda jis ki chonch lambi aur patli hai; neeche Pigeon (kabootar), grey jis ki gardan par hara-jamuni dhabba hai, tehni par baitha.

blocks.text: Bahar ke nathne (external nares) naak ke raston se pharynx mein khulte hain. Pharynx se trachea aur phir bronchi tak rasta jata hai. Awaaz ka organ, syrinx, trachea ke nichle sire par hota hai. Bronchi hawa ki thailiyon (air sacs) ke ek complex system tak jati hain, jo jism ke bare hisse mein phaili hoti hain aur kuch haddiyon ke andar tak jati hain. Air sacs lungs se juri hoti hain; lungs hawa ki chhoti naliyon (parabronchi) se bane hote hain.

Reptiles aur mammals ki tarah birds ke bhi amniotic eggs hote hain jin mein bohat sa yolk aur albumin hota hai. Parindon ke ande par sakht, calcium carbonate ka khol (hard calcareous shell) hota hai. Birds mein fertilization internal aur development jism ke bahar (external) hoti hai, yani yeh oviparous hain. Kuch parindon ne baad mein urne ki taqat kho di; inhein running birds (daurne wale parinde) kehte hain, jaise shuturmurgh (ostrich), kiwi, rhea, cassowary aur emu. Urne wale parinde: kabootar (pigeon), tota (parrot), kawwa (crow), uqaab (eagle), robin wagaira.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke parindon ke ande par chamre jaisa (leathery) khol hota hai. Yeh sahi nahi: parinde ke ande ka khol sakht hota hai aur zyada tar calcium carbonate ka bana hota hai (murghi ka anda dekhein). Chamre jaisa narm khol bohat se reptiles, jaise saanp aur aksar chhipkaliyon, ke andon par hota hai.
